verses.original: אָ֭דָם יְל֣וּד אִשָּׁ֑ה קְצַ֥ר יָ֝מִ֗ים וּֽשְׂבַֽע־ רֹֽגֶז׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḏām yə·lūḏ ’iš·šāh qə·ṣar yā·mîm ū·śə·ḇa‘- rō·ḡez
verses.literal: Man who is born of woman is short of days and full of trouble

verses.original: כְּצִ֣יץ יָ֭צָא וַיִּמָּ֑ל כַּ֝צֵּ֗ל וַיִּבְרַ֥ח וְלֹ֣א יַעֲמֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ṣîṣ yā·ṣā way·yim·māl kaṣ·ṣêl way·yiḇ·raḥ wə·lō ya·‘ă·mō·wḏ
verses.literal: Like a flower he comes forth then withers away like a fleeting shadow . . . he does not endure

verses.original: פָּקַ֣חְתָּ עֵינֶ֑ךָ וְאֹ֘תִ֤י זֶ֭ה תָבִ֖יא בְמִשְׁפָּ֣ט אַף־ עִמָּֽךְ׃ עַל־
verses.transliteration: pā·qaḥ·tā ‘ê·ne·ḵā wə·’ō·ṯî zeh ṯā·ḇî ḇə·miš·pāṭ ’ap̄- ‘im·māḵ ‘al-
verses.literal: Do You open Your eyes - to one like this Will You bring him into judgment before You

verses.original: מִֽי־ יִתֵּ֣ן טָ֭הוֹר מִטָּמֵ֗א לֹ֣א אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: mî- yit·tên ṭā·hō·wr miṭ·ṭā·mê lō ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: Who can bring out clean from unclean No one

verses.original: אִ֥ם יָמָ֗יו חֲרוּצִ֨ים׀ מִֽסְפַּר־ חֳדָשָׁ֥יו אִתָּ֑ךְ עָ֝שִׂ֗יתָ חֻקּוֹ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲבֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ’im yā·māw ḥă·rū·ṣîm mis·par- ḥo·ḏā·šāw ’it·tāḵ ‘ā·śî·ṯā ḥuq·qō wə·lō ya·‘ă·ḇō·wr
verses.literal: Since his days [are] determined and the number of his months [is] with You and since You have set limits that he cannot exceed

verses.original: שְׁעֵ֣ה מֵעָלָ֣יו וְיֶחְדָּ֑ל עַד־ יִ֝רְצֶ֗ה יוֹמֽוֹ׃ כְּשָׂכִ֥יר
verses.transliteration: šə·‘êh mê·‘ā·lāw wə·yeḥ·dāl ‘aḏ- yir·ṣeh yō·w·mōw kə·śā·ḵîr
verses.literal: look away from him and let him rest so he can enjoy his day as a hired hand

verses.original: כִּ֤י יֵ֥שׁ תִּ֫קְוָ֥ה לָעֵ֗ץ אִֽם־ יִ֭כָּרֵת יַחֲלִ֑יף וְע֣וֹד וְ֝יֹֽנַקְתּ֗וֹ לֹ֣א תֶחְדָּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kî yêš tiq·wāh lā·‘êṣ ’im- yik·kā·rêṯ ya·ḥă·lîp̄ wə·‘ō·wḏ wə·yō·naq·tōw lō ṯeḥ·dāl
verses.literal: For there is hope for a tree If it is cut down it will sprout again and its tender shoots will not fail

verses.original: אִם־ שָׁרְשׁ֑וֹ יַזְקִ֣ין בָּאָ֣רֶץ גִּזְעֽוֹ׃ יָמ֥וּת וּ֝בֶעָפָ֗ר
verses.transliteration: ’im- šā·rə·šōw yaz·qîn bā·’ā·reṣ giz·‘ōw yā·mūṯ ū·ḇe·‘ā·p̄ār
verses.literal: If its roots grow old in the ground and its stump dies in the soil

verses.original: מֵרֵ֣יחַ מַ֣יִם יַפְרִ֑חַ וְעָשָׂ֖ה קָצִ֣יר כְּמוֹ־ נָֽטַע׃
verses.transliteration: mê·rê·aḥ ma·yim yap̄·ri·aḥ wə·‘ā·śāh qā·ṣîr kə·mōw- nā·ṭa‘
verses.literal: at the scent of water it will bud and put forth twigs like a sapling

verses.original: וְגֶ֣בֶר יָ֭מוּת וַֽיֶּחֱלָ֑שׁ אָדָ֣ם וַיִּגְוַ֖ע וְאַיּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡe·ḇer yā·mūṯ way·ye·ḥĕ·lāš ’ā·ḏām way·yiḡ·wa‘ wə·’ay·yōw
verses.literal: But a man dies and is laid low he breathes his last and where [is] he

verses.original: מַ֭יִם אָֽזְלוּ־ מִנִּי־ יָ֑ם וְ֝נָהָ֗ר יֶחֱרַ֥ב וְיָבֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ma·yim ’ā·zə·lū- min·nî- yām wə·nā·hār ye·ḥĕ·raḇ wə·yā·ḇêš
verses.literal: As water disappears from the sea and a river becomes parched and dry

verses.original: וְאִ֥ישׁ שָׁכַ֗ב וְֽלֹא־ יָ֫ק֥וּם עַד־ שָׁ֭מַיִם בִּלְתִּ֣י לֹ֣א יָקִ֑יצוּ וְלֹֽא־ יֵ֝עֹ֗רוּ מִשְּׁנָתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš šā·ḵaḇ wə·lō- yā·qūm ‘aḏ- šā·ma·yim bil·tî lō yā·qî·ṣū wə·lō- yê·‘ō·rū miš·šə·nā·ṯām
verses.literal: so a man lies down and does not rise Until the heavens are no more he will not be awakened [or] roused from sleep

verses.original: מִ֤י יִתֵּ֨ן׀ תַּצְפִּנֵ֗נִי בִּשְׁא֬וֹל תַּ֭סְתִּירֵנִי עַד־ אַפֶּ֑ךָ שׁ֣וּב תָּ֤שִׁ֥ית חֹ֣ק לִ֖י וְתִזְכְּרֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: mî yit·tên taṣ·pi·nê·nî biš·’ō·wl tas·tî·rê·nî ‘aḏ- ’ap·pe·ḵā šūḇ tā·šîṯ ḥōq lî wə·ṯiz·kə·rê·nî
verses.literal: If only . . . You would hide me in Sheol and conceal me until Your anger has passed If only You would appoint a time for me and then remember me

verses.original: אִם־ גֶּ֗בֶר יָמ֥וּת הֲיִ֫חְיֶ֥ה כָּל־ יְמֵ֣י צְבָאִ֣י אֲיַחֵ֑ל עַד־ חֲלִיפָתִֽי׃ בּ֝֗וֹא
verses.transliteration: ’im- ge·ḇer yā·mūṯ hă·yiḥ·yeh kāl- yə·mê ṣə·ḇā·’î ’ă·ya·ḥêl ‘aḏ- ḥă·lî·p̄ā·ṯî bō·w
verses.literal: When a man dies will he live [again] All the days of my hard service I will wait until my renewal comes

verses.original: תִּ֭קְרָא וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ךָּ תִכְסֹֽף׃ לְֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדֶ֣יךָ
verses.transliteration: tiq·rā wə·’ā·nō·ḵî ’e·‘ĕ·ne·kā ṯiḵ·sōp̄ lə·ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: You will call and I will answer You will desire the work of Your hands

verses.original: כִּֽי־ עַ֭תָּה תִּסְפּ֑וֹר צְעָדַ֣י לֹֽא־ תִ֝שְׁמ֗וֹר עַל־ חַטָּאתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ‘at·tāh tis·pō·wr ṣə·‘ā·ḏay lō- ṯiš·mō·wr ‘al- ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯî
verses.literal: For then You would count my steps but would not keep track of my sin

verses.original: פִּשְׁעִ֑י חָתֻ֣ם בִּצְר֣וֹר וַ֝תִּטְפֹּ֗ל עַל־ עֲוֺנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: piš·‘î ḥā·ṯum biṣ·rō·wr wat·tiṭ·pōl ‘al- ‘ă·wō·nî
verses.literal: My transgression would be sealed in a bag and You would cover over my iniquity

verses.original: וְ֭אוּלָם הַר־ נוֹפֵ֣ל יִבּ֑וֹל וְ֝צ֗וּר יֶעְתַּ֥ק מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ū·lām har- nō·w·p̄êl yib·bō·wl wə·ṣūr ye‘·taq mim·mə·qō·mōw
verses.literal: But as a mountain erodes and crumbles and a rock is dislodged from its place

verses.original: מַ֗יִם שָׁ֥חֲקוּ אֲבָנִ֤ים׀ סְפִיחֶ֥יהָ תִּשְׁטֹֽף־ עֲפַר־ אָ֑רֶץ הֶאֱבַֽדְתָּ׃ אֱנ֣וֹשׁ וְתִקְוַ֖ת
verses.transliteration: ma·yim šā·ḥă·qū ’ă·ḇā·nîm sə·p̄î·ḥe·hā tiš·ṭōp̄- ‘ă·p̄ar- ’ā·reṣ he·’ĕ·ḇaḏ·tā ’ĕ·nō·wōš wə·ṯiq·waṯ
verses.literal: as water wears away the stones and torrents wash away the soil . . . so You destroy a man’s hope

verses.original: לָ֭נֶצַח תִּתְקְפֵ֣הוּ וַֽיַּהֲלֹ֑ךְ מְשַׁנֶּ֥ה פָ֝נָ֗יו וַֽתְּשַׁלְּחֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ne·ṣaḥ tiṯ·qə·p̄ê·hū way·ya·hă·lōḵ mə·šan·neh p̄ā·nāw wat·tə·šal·lə·ḥê·hū
verses.literal: You forever overpower him and he passes on You change his countenance and send him away

verses.original: בָ֭נָיו יִכְבְּד֣וּ וְלֹ֣א יֵדָ֑ע וְ֝יִצְעֲר֗וּ וְֽלֹא־ יָבִ֥ין לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ḇā·nāw yiḵ·bə·ḏū wə·lō yê·ḏā‘ wə·yiṣ·‘ă·rū wə·lō- yā·ḇîn lā·mōw
verses.literal: If his sons receive honor he does not know it if they are brought low he is unaware . . .

verses.original: אַךְ־ יִכְאָ֑ב בְּ֭שָׂרוֹ תֶּאֱבָֽל׃פ עָלָ֣יו וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ עָלָ֥יו
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ- yiḵ·’āḇ bə·śā·rōw te·’ĕ·ḇāl ‘ā·lāw wə·nap̄·šōw ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: He feels only the pain of his own body and mourns only for himself . . .
